evidence_boundary: Yale 136Pm settings overlap Starosta in entrance channel and 130 MeV. Printed exit channel and detector count differ; do not count independent 136Pm measurements without acquisition evidence.
138Eu was collected with the separate Cd+Cl Eurogam experiment, and this article explicitly reuses the same 138Eu stream as Ref. [10].
DCO, polarization asymmetry and inferred bandhead spin have distinct roles. No calibrated polarization reprocessing or additional delta results are claimed.
